source.citation: Dantis, M. C., & Lacap, M. P. (2021). Aquatic Macrofauna Assessment Along Agno River in the Province of Pangasinan, Philippines. Southeast Asian Journal of Science and Technology, 6(1), 88-97. Published 10 December 2021.
source.attributionAndChanges: Attribute Dantis and Lacap, article title, journal, volume/issue/pages, publisher record and CC BY 4.0; clearly label any corrections or extracted-name review as modifications.

study.reportedLocationMethod: GPS stations mapped with Google Earth 2016; the reviewed article text does not provide coordinate values or a machine-readable station file.
study.samplingMethod: Belt-transect quadrat sampling: three 1 m by 1 m faunal plots inside a 10 m by 10 m quadrat at each site; the paper describes a 10 percent sampling fraction.
study.identificationClaim: Morphological appraisal used taxonomic references; the paper says species were authenticated by approved agencies but does not identify the agencies or voucher accession numbers in the reviewed text.
study.sourceScope: A historical pooled survey across five stations; it is not a station-by-species matrix. The paper specifically says high tides at station 5 in Lingayen yielded marine taxa, so the pooled list must not be labelled uniformly freshwater.

sourceReportedTotals.resolution: Unresolved source-internal count allocation conflict. Both partitions total 32; use neither without preserving the discrepancy.

fishNameCandidates.normalization: Article prose spells genus/species as Sarotherodon melanotheron; retain the Table 1 string pending authority check.
Authority-year requires independent check; source text also contains other spelling errors.
Article discussion later uses Moolgarda pedaraka; keep both source spellings for taxonomy review.

additionalTextOnlyLabel.whereFound: Narrative species list, not Table 1 fish checklist.
additionalTextOnlyLabel.disposition: Keep separate; do not silently add it to or reconcile the stated total of 23 fish.

qualityAndLocalityIssues: Abstract and body/table disagree on crustacean versus mollusk counts.
Narrative list includes a genus-only Trichogaster sp. absent from Table 1; a simple deduplicated narrative tally does not match the table total.
Station coordinates are said to have been GPS-recorded, but the reviewed article text exposes no coordinates or downloadable station dataset.
Only station 5 is named as Lingayen in the reviewed results; the other stations lack a clear locality crosswalk here.
Table spellings and author-years require independent taxonomic review; do not silently normalize labels or treat name matching as voucher verification.
The authors' reported identification authentication does not itself substitute for accessible voucher identifiers or independent specimen review.

disposition.reason: Historical pooled records, site-coordinate gap, mixed marine/freshwater influence, internal table/prose conflicts and pending independent name review. This source may support future attributed historical research, but not station-level, current, catchability, habitat-preference or advice claims as reviewed.

nextAction: Cross-check the verbatim table spellings and authorities against an independent fish taxonomy; if proceeding toward historical species assertions, obtain the station map/data or author clarification for stations 1-4 and evaluate each marine/brackish/freshwater claim separately.
